name: 39443 · Laurel, MS
findings: ZIP 39443 (Laurel) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39443 (Laurel) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39443 (Laurel) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
